title: Investigating Bias in LLM-Based Bias Detection: Disparities between LLMs and Human Perception

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs on media political ideology prediction tasks (classifying articles as left, center, or right) using a custom Bias Tendency Index (BTI) to compare against human ground-truth labels, and analyzing the political orientation of LLM-generated text in article continuation tasks using embedding-based similarity matching and left/right vocabulary-based matching.
